title: P-036: Stale source lowers confidence; display only when decision-relevant
summary: The email source was last fetched 36 hours ago (threshold: 24h — stale). relationship_signals.py should mark signals from email as freshness=stale_source_limited and cap confidence at 0.55 per P-036. If the underlying signal would otherwise be strong enough to propose RI, the stale gate should block it. The brief should surface a staleness warning only if it affects the operator's decision (e.g., an active thread contact may have emailed but RB cannot confirm).

expected_behavior.display_recommendation: show if active-thread relevant; suppress_unless_asked otherwise

steps.label: email source marked stale
steps.description: source_health.json shows email.fetched_at = 2026-05-23T22:00:00Z (36h ago; threshold 24h). _freshness() in daily_brief.py returns stale_or_missing for email.

steps.label: _apply_freshness_labels propagates to signals
steps.description: relationship_signals.py calls _apply_freshness_labels; email-sourced signals get freshness=stale_source_limited. _ri_assessment_for_signal() caps confidence at 0.55 and sets status=blocked with reason containing 'source_freshness=stale'.

steps.label: Brief shows staleness warning for active-thread contacts
steps.description: If an active-thread contact (e.g., Bob Gibson / Toast) may have emailed but the source is stale, the brief surfaces: 'Email is stale (36h) — I cannot confirm whether Bob Gibson replied to your active thread. Refresh email to check.' This is decision-relevant so it IS displayed.
steps.example_response: Email source is stale (fetched 36h ago; threshold 24h). I cannot confirm whether contacts on active threads have emailed. My confidence for email-based signals is limited.
steps.forbidden_response: Bob Gibson replied to your email — I propose recording a touch.

steps.label: Brief suppresses stale warning for non-relevant contacts
steps.description: For non-active-thread, non-RC contacts, the stale-source warning is NOT shown individually. The brief surfaces a single aggregate staleness notice in the Resource Verification section, not per-contact noise.

acceptance_criteria: stale email source caps confidence at 0.55 per P-036
brief shows staleness warning when it affects active-thread decision
brief does NOT show per-contact RI claims from stale data
no stale source produces a confident RI claim
anti_patterns: confidence stays at 0.75+ when source is stale
proposing a touch mutation based on a stale email signal
silently suppressing the stale warning even when it affects active-thread judgment
